svg.text: Event-driven, CQRS, outbox pattern • Go multi-module workspace + React SPA
outbox • inbox • SnsDispatcher • pg logical replication
1. Command handler writes domain row + outbox row atomically in one DB transaction
2. message_broker tails WAL via pg_output logical replication slot (or polls outbox table)
3. SnsDispatcher publishes event to SNS topic on commit (marks outbox row produced=true)
event-ledger-http/sqs • journal-http/sqs (ARM64 binaries via GitHub Actions)
vendor → build-testing → build-message-broker → build-bookings / build-authentication / build-event-ledger (parallel) → build-ui → Lambda deploy (ARM64)
